acceptanceResults: EN: Domain types represent Goods Identity, Goods Profile, Observation, Expectation, Goods State and Health Assessment with only the minimal fields needed for this demo. JA: Domain type は Goods Identity、Goods Profile、Observation、Expectation、Goods State、Health Assessment を demo に必要な最小 field だけで表現する。ZH: Domain 类型只用 demo 所需的最小字段表示 Goods Identity、Goods Profile、Observation、Expectation、Goods State 和 Health Assessment。

EN: The application port owns observation acquisition and the infrastructure adapter is a synthetic DemoObservationSource; no real POS contract or transport dependency is introduced. JA: observation acquisition は application port が所有し、infrastructure adapter は synthetic な DemoObservationSource とする。real POS contract や transport dependency は追加しない。ZH: observation acquisition 由 application port 所有，infrastructure adapter 是 synthetic 的 DemoObservationSource；不增加真实 POS contract 或传输依赖。

EN: A product-independent runtime observes a Goods value, applies its profile expectation, and produces a traceable health assessment without a tuna-mayo-specific branch. JA: 商品非依存の runtime が Goods を observe し、profile expectation を適用して、ツナマヨ専用分岐なしに traceable な health assessment を生成する。ZH: 与具体商品无关的 runtime 能观察 Goods、应用 profile expectation 并生成可追溯的 health assessment，不出现饭团专用分支。

EN: The CLI demo runs locally from the repository and visibly labels its input as synthetic/example, showing identity, observation, expectation and current health. JA: CLI demo は repository から local 実行でき、input を synthetic/example と明示し、identity、observation、expectation、current health を表示する。ZH: CLI demo 可以在仓库本地运行，并明确标记输入为 synthetic/example，显示 identity、observation、expectation 和当前健康状态。

EN: No Need, Care, Memory, Learning, emotion, autonomous action, real POS, database, HTTP, API or LLM behavior is implemented. JA: Need、Care、Memory、Learning、emotion、自律 action、real POS、database、HTTP、API、LLM の挙動を実装しない。ZH: 不实现 Need、Care、Memory、Learning、情绪、自主行动、真实 POS、数据库、HTTP、API 或 LLM 行为。

EN: English, Japanese and Chinese project documentation records the Phase 1 boundary, synthetic-data limitation and runnable demo path. JA: English、日本語、中文の project documentation が Phase 1 boundary、synthetic-data limitation、demo 実行方法を記録する。ZH: 英文、日语、中文项目文档记录 Phase 1 边界、synthetic 数据限制和 demo 运行方式。

EN: cargo fmt --check, cargo check --workspace, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace, cargo run -p goods-garden-cli -- demo and git diff --check pass. JA: 指定された Cargo quality command、local demo、git diff --check が通る。ZH: 指定的 Cargo quality command、本地 demo 和 git diff --check 全部通过。
